newsitem.title: USA: Mobil says Chalmette refinery had fire.
newsitem.headline: Mobil says Chalmette refinery had fire.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Thursday its Chalmette, Louisiana refinery had a fire in the early morning in its hydrocracking unit.
"We had a fire in the hydrocracking unit at 4.40 (0540 EDT), it was isolated by 4.45 and was out by 5.30," Mobil spokesperson Sandy Dewey said.
She would not comment on whether units were idled by the fire.

The hydrocracker, which converts middle distillates to high-octane gasoline, has a capacity of just under 20,000 barrels per day (bpd). The plant has a crude distillation capacity of around 173,00 bpd.
There was no impact on the community and no injuries, Dewey said.
